snippet.title: Idle Critter Adventure - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Want to catch and battle monsters on your desktop but you don't want to be actively playing it all the time? Idle Critter Adventure is a new Idle game where you can choose a route to travel and Alfa will battle, level up and capture new Critters along the way. The longer he runs down a route, the higher chance of encountering rare Critters!

Travel across the world collecting badges and take on the Champion to prestige and gain upgrades for your next adventure.

Coming soon to Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457230/Idle_Critter_Adventure/
